notes.title: Second Big Update is Out!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We just released v1.2.0 that includes following major that brings gaming time visual warnings to our fellow gamers. While in game, now you will receive an overlay warning that reminds you that you are really close to your time limit so you can react accordingly. Aside from that v1.2.0 is bundled with minor fixes and adjustments as well. Below you can find the changelog;

notes.title: First Big Update is Out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are very excited to announce that our first major update is out! With this update you will get Sentinel Signal Tray Icon that will keep track of whether Sentinel Signal runs and it will restart it for you in case it is shutdown to ensure that all your gaming sessions are accounted for. Of course you have option to disable auto-restart which you can do so by right clicking to the Sentinel tray icon and opting out of the auto-restart. We also added a quick introduction screen for our new users as well!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1
notes.notes: Previously our application required user to enter serial key to activate the application however we removed this feature due to relevant licensing processes are handled by steam.
